# Command Reference

Every Verda CLI command, grouped as in `verda --help`. Each entry links to its reference page with
usage, flags and examples. The pages are generated from the CLI's own help text.

See also: [Authentication](guides/authentication.md) · [Scripting and agent mode](guides/scripting.md) ·
[Agent error format](agent-errors.md) · [AI skills](ai-skills.md)

## Auth Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`verda auth`](reference/auth.md) | Manage shared credentials and profiles |
| [`verda auth login`](reference/auth.md#verda-auth-login) | Save API credentials for a profile |
| [`verda auth show`](reference/auth.md#verda-auth-show) | Show the resolved auth profile |
| [`verda auth use`](reference/auth.md#verda-auth-use) | Switch the active auth profile |

## VM Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`verda ssh`](reference/ssh.md) | SSH into a running VM instance |
| [`verda vm`](reference/vm.md) | Manage virtual machines |
| [`verda vm action`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-action) | Perform actions on a VM instance |
| [`verda vm availability`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-availability) | Show available instance types with specs and pricing |
| [`verda vm create`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-create) | Create a VM instance |
| [`verda vm delete`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-delete) | Delete a VM instance |
| [`verda vm describe`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-describe) | Show detailed information about a VM instance |
| [`verda vm hibernate`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-hibernate) | Hibernate a VM instance (deprecated, will be removed in a future version) |
| [`verda vm list`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-list) | List VM instances |
| [`verda vm shutdown`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-shutdown) | Shutdown a VM instance |
| [`verda vm start`](reference/vm.md#verda-vm-start) | Start a VM instance |

## Serverless Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| [`verda container`](reference/container.md) (beta) | Manage serverless container deployments (always-on endpoints) |
| [`verda container create`](reference/container.md#verda-container-create) | Create a serverless container deployment |
| [`verda container delete`](reference/container.md#verda-container-delete) | Delete a container deployment |
| [`verda container describe`](reference/container.md#verda-container-describe) | Show details of a container deployment |
| [`verda container list`](reference/container.md#verda-container-list) | List serverless container deployments |
| [`verda container pause`](reference/container.md#verda-container-pause) | Pause a container deployment |
| [`verda container purge-queue`](reference/container.md#verda-container-purge-queue) | Purge the pending-request queue for a container deployment |
| [`verda container replicas`](reference/container.md#verda-container-replicas) | List the replicas of a container deployment |
| [`verda container restart`](reference/container.md#verda-container-restart) | Restart a container deployment |
| [`verda container resume`](reference/container.md#verda-container-resume) | Resume a paused container deployment |
| [`verda container scale`](reference/container.md#verda-container-scale) | Change the scaling options of a container deployment |

## Global Flags

```text
      --agent              Agent mode: JSON output, no interactive prompts, structured errors
      --base-url string    API base URL (default "https://api.verda.com/v1")
      --config string      Path to a verda config file (YAML)
      --debug              Enable debug output
  -o, --output string      Output format: table, json, yaml (default "table")
      --timeout duration   Default HTTP request timeout (default 30s)
  -v, --version            Print version information
```
